design_rationale:
WORKLOG / TEST DOSSIER — task 0 of home_claim_settlement (HomeGuard wind/hail occurrence, frozen 2026-09-17).

[Step 0 — draw and scope] draw_counts.py --task 0 printed {"prerequisite_problems": 1, "problems": 2, "factor_counts": [5, 5]}. Tree: root home_ext_structure_supplemental (5 factors) <- prerequisite home_ext_roof_denial_reversal (5 factors). Nothing was occupied before this task. Claimed: the two policies above and tools settle_denied_roof_surfacing_b6cb399f (agent) and accept_structure_supplemental_c73fec14 (user). Reserved for task 1 (draw 6/4/4, two prerequisites): the water-peril space (hidden water, mold and water-backup sublimits, personal property, loss of use), none of which this task reads or writes. Why these writes: the home charter keeps no adjuster estimate outside the claim ledger, so every scored figure of the difficulty is a re-settlement of replacement-cost and depreciation figures already recorded on a payment or denial entry.

[Why this is a good test] The customer only says the July garage check carried a deductible of more than ten thousand dollars against a one percent wind deductible. To answer him the agent must (1) read the garage rule and find its prerequisite sentence "The other-structures supplemental figure is fixed only after the roof surfacing of the same claim carries a payment entry wherever that roof surfacing was denied below the deductible.", (2) see in the ledger that the claim has no dwelling payment entry, only a below-deductible roof denial (RC 14,400.00, dep 3,700.00) measured against a 2 percent deductible, (3) work out from the roof reversal rule that its write is the one that puts a deductible on a dwelling payment entry, (4) re-settle the roof on the roof schedule with four more factors, and only then (5) settle the garage on the world that write leaves. Difficulty comes from reading policy, reconciling 14 home claim entries across three claims plus the FloodGuard ledger, and arithmetic — never from tool choice (one tool per problem).

[Problem-tree card] root home_ext_structure_supplemental; edge -> home_ext_roof_denial_reversal, kind value_input, gate dw_abs (compute binding of the root), form state, prerequisite sentence (policy_source) "The other-structures supplemental figure is fixed only after the roof surfacing of the same claim carries a payment entry wherever that roof surfacing was denied below the deductible." Four-point test: ordering connective "only after", affirmative direction (a figure 'is fixed only after' what it rests on — the way a claim desk states it); the waited-on side is a record-visible state (the deductible field of the claim's dwelling payment entries), no action, performer or tool named; no tool, policy id or snake_case token; strength 'only after' is a hard requirement, scope 'the same claim'. Exactly one write of the difficulty brings that state about: the state is a roof surfacing payment entry on a claim whose roof surfacing was denied below the deductible, and only the roof reversal writes roof surfacing payments (the water reversal also writes dwelling payments, but of the general class, replacing a repeated-seepage denial on a freeze or discharge claim; audit round 1 found the earlier wording of this sentence named a state both could produce, so the sentence was narrowed). Derivation: sentence + records (a below-deductible roof surfacing denial with no roof surfacing payment entry) + the roof reversal rule ("fixes the amount of the payment that replaces the denial", "the roof surfacing absorbs the smaller of the occurrence deductible and its covered amount") -> the reversal is the resolving action. condition: the below-deductible roof surfacing denial is matched by a roof surfacing payment entry carrying the deductible the roof surfacing absorbs; resolved_by settle_denied_roof_surfacing_b6cb399f (owner agent). Seed evidence false at opening: home_claims.<c26_den>.denial_reason = below_deductible, no dwelling home_claim_payment on HGC-26-138204, home_claims.<c26_pay>.deductible_applied = 10800.0. Topological order: reversal (step 7) then supplemental (step 9). Deletion sensitivity (actual run): skipping step 7 turns the garage supplemental from 15,258.00 into 8,543.00 (dw_abs 5,400.00 -> 0.00, os_ded 0.00 -> 5,400.00, trades 3 -> 2). user_scenario never names the roof, the denial or the dwelling; the tools validate nothing (see prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block). The customer's own write is the root (accept_structure_supplemental_c73fec14, owner user): accepting a supplemental settlement on his own claim is a confirmation only the named insured gives, completed on the spot.

[Factor card — home_ext_roof_denial_reversal, expected 4,700.00, baseline_result 2,520.00] (revision 3)
- The settlement basis is not a factor: the roof reversal follows the basis the declarations carry for the term (base home_roof_settlement), here roof_surfacing_schedule, set at the 2026-04-15 renewal; covered = 14,400.00 x 55 percent (age 2026 - 2009 = 17) = 7,920.00. The audit (T0-R2-1) showed that a basis ladder mirroring the renewal logic is readable off that field, so the basis became a plain read and the method factor moved.
- prior_unrepaired_roof (method: the tiers choose which quantities make up the deduction — money issued, or money issued plus the still-standing holdback): HGC-24-125913 roof acv_initial 1,150.00 inside 36 months, holdback 1,500.00 forfeited -> deduct 1,150.00. Near-miss: deducting the forfeited 1,500.00 as well. Baseline 0 -> 5,850.00.
- roof_code_upgrade (parameter, multi-source): built 1961 AND ordinance-or-law 25 -> 10 percent = 1,440.00. Baseline 0 -> 3,260.00.
- roof_tearoff_disposal (parameter): asphalt, RC 14,400.00 >= 10,000.00 -> 5 percent = 720.00. Baseline 0 -> 3,980.00.
- roof_matching (parameter): asphalt roof 17 years old -> 5 percent = 720.00 (Ohio uniform-appearance practice; shingle lines change after about a decade). Not readable off roof_settlement: a schedule roof on this tier can be 16 to 19 (5 percent) or 20+ (10 percent). Baseline 0 -> 3,980.00.
- roof_emergency_tarp (parameter): reported 1 day after the loss -> 450.00. Baseline 0 -> 4,250.00.
[Factor card — home_ext_structure_supplemental, expected 15,258.00, baseline_result 5,450.00]
- structure_settlement_method (method): RC 26,300.00 > threshold 2,500.00 AND release 5,350.00 (incurred 24,950.00) stands -> min(RC, documented cost) - deductible = 24,950.00. Baseline ACV 19,600.00 -> 9,908.00.
- storm_job_overhead_profit (parameter, cross-difficulty flood): trades = garage acv_initial + roof roof_schedule reversal + FloodGuard FGC-26-104782 detached-structures payment with loss date 2026-06-22 = 3 -> 10 percent = 2,630.00. Baseline 0 -> 12,628.00. Forcing the flood read off drops the tier to 5 percent.
- structure_permit_allowance (parameter): 26,300.00 >= 25,000.00 -> 2 percent = 526.00. Baseline 0 -> 14,732.00.
- structure_haul_away (parameter): depreciation 6,700.00 >= 25 percent x 26,300.00 = 6,575.00 -> 4 percent = 1,052.00 (an aged structure is torn out, not repaired in place; the ladder no longer depends on the cause of loss). Baseline 0 -> 14,206.00.
- member_tenure_credit (parameter, multi-source): 197 months since 2010-04-15 AND 2 claims with a loss date in the 36 months before the call -> 250.00. Near-miss: theft claim HGC-23-117406 with loss 2023-08-30 is exactly 36 whole months back and falls outside the window; counting it gives 3 claims and no credit. Baseline 0 -> 15,008.00.
No factor rests on a stamp; every tier rests on seeded ledger rows, policy dates, or the flood ledger.

[Base-invariant card] Subject home_claim_payment is governed by home_claim_settlement (gate claim_opened: "A payment is issued only on a claim number opened by first notice of loss." — satisfied by first-notice entry <c26_rep> claim_number HGC-26-138204, bound to the claim_number argument of both writes), home_roof_settlement, home_water_limitations and home_depreciation_recovery (no gate applying to home_claim_payment: policy_scope). No time gate applies to a claim payment. Overwrites declared: home_roof_settlement schedule sentence and replacement-cost sentence (the reversal adds allowances and reads the roof's age and material instead of the stamp), home_claim_settlement settlement sentence (twice) and the absorption-order clause (the garage absorbs what the dwelling payment entries leave).

[Business-object card] Target claim HGC-26-138204 (latest first notice). Included: its denial <c26_den> (roof figures), garage acv <c26_pay>, holdback <c26_hold>, release <c26_rel>, recoverable-depreciation payment <c26_recov>. Excluded by claim number: HGC-24-125913 (read only by the prior-unrepaired ladder) and HGC-23-117406 (read only by the tenure count). Flood rows are read-only evidence.

[Persona design] A precise retired chemistry teacher; volunteers only the garage complaint and the facts it rests on (claim number, rebuilt garage, depreciation check in September, the >10,000 deductible, one percent on the declarations — all on file). Only when asked: phone, date of birth, ZIP, email, mortgagee, the FloodGuard claim. Passive: consents to preliminary work, accepts the figure the agent reads when handed the tool, closes when told it is issued. No roof mention, no figure of his own.

[Standard solution] find_customers -> verify (phone + DOB) -> find_home_policies -> find_home_claims -> find_flood_policies -> find_flood_claims -> unlock + call settle_denied_roof_surfacing_b6cb399f (roof_schedule, age 17, deductible 5,400.00, amount 4,700.00, insured_and_mortgagee) -> unlock_user + customer calls accept_structure_supplemental_c73fec14 (15,258.00, insured_and_mortgagee).

[Verification runs] scratchpad evaluator (check_compute.build_env/eval_compute on the replayed handling-time world): PA result 4700.0 (revision 3), factor baselines 5850.0 / 3260.0 / 3980.0 / 3980.0 / 4250.0, all-baseline 2520.0; PB result 15258.0, factor baselines 9908.0 / 12628.0 / 14732.0 / 14206.0 / 15008.0, all-baseline 5450.0; PB with step 7 skipped 8543.0. Gate outputs are recorded in the difficulty worklog.

[Draft recomputation from the visible context] From the published rules, the tool schemas and the lookups alone: the garage rule says its figure waits for the dwelling payment entries to carry the dwelling's deductible; the ledger has none; the roof reversal rule is the one that issues a dwelling payment replacing a below-deductible denial; recomputing both gives 4,700.00 and 15,258.00, identical to gold. Traps a careful reader excludes: the 2 percent deductible on the July entries, the 2023 claim at exactly 36 months, the 1,350.00 holdback still standing on the garage (not money issued).

[Revisions] v1 initial authoring. v2 (audit round 1): T0-R1/G-6 — the structure prerequisite sentence now waits on 'the roof surfacing of the same claim carries a payment entry wherever that roof surfacing was denied below the deductible', a state only the roof reversal writes; condition, effect and the problem-tree card updated. G-5 — waiver sums count payment entries that replace no denial (40,700.00 before and after the roof write). T0-O1 — roof_settlement seeded as roof_surfacing_schedule (renewal re-evaluation). O-6 — haul-away ladder keyed on depreciation share only. Roof rule scope now says wind or hail; the roof_settlement schedule clause is replaced_by the schedule sentence. Re-run: 3,530.00 and 15,258.00 unchanged, all factor baselines unchanged, skip-edge value 8,543.00 unchanged.
 v3 (audit round 2): T0-R2-1 — the roof reversal no longer carries a basis-method ladder that mirrors the renewal logic behind roof_settlement; it follows the declared basis as base does (plain read), and the roof's method factor is prior_unrepaired_roof (relabelled; its tiers choose the aggregation, as the round-1 O-3 note observed). Two parameter factors added: roof_matching (asphalt age 10-19 / 20+) and roof_emergency_tarp (days to first notice). Roof amount 3,530.00 -> 4,700.00; the garage supplemental 15,258.00 and its skip value 8,543.00 are unchanged because the garage reads only the roof entry's deductible, class and payment kind. R2-O2 — the garage policy's scope is now wind or hail claims, so no water reversal can move its deductible read.
user_scenario: You are Thaddeus Okonkwo-Varga, a retired high-school chemistry teacher who has lived at 2291 Hollowbrook Lane in Worthington, Ohio for sixteen years. You speak slowly and precisely, like someone used to grading lab reports, and you like to hear figures read back to you. The windstorm on June 22, 2026 tore the roof and one wall off your detached two-car garage; your claim number is HGC-26-138204. You had the garage rebuilt over the summer, sent in the contractor's final invoice, and a recoverable depreciation check arrived in early September. What you are calling about is the garage: the first garage check in July had a deductible of more than ten thousand dollars taken off it, while your declarations page shows a one percent wind deductible on a home insured for 540,000 dollars, so you want the garage part of this claim looked at and settled the way your policy says. You do not know how a deductible is split across a claim and you do not suggest any figure of your own. You open by giving your name and saying you are calling about your garage claim. When the agent asks you to confirm who you are, you give your phone number, 216-418-7733, and your date of birth, 1971-08-26; only if they ask for more do you add your ZIP code, 43085, or your email, thaddeus.okvarga@brightlane.net. If the agent asks about the mortgage, Olentangy Valley Savings Bank still holds it and the loan number is 1187-440-2963, exactly as on file. If the agent asks about flood insurance, you say yes, you have a FloodGuard policy on the house and the creek came up into the garage that same night, and FloodGuard paid something on the garage in July; you do not remember the amount. If the agent tells you that something else on the claim has to be put right before the garage figure can be settled, you tell them to go ahead and do whatever the policy calls for; you ask nothing more about it. Whatever money is still owed on the garage, you want to accept it yourself rather than have it simply sent: once the agent tells you the figure and hands the acceptance over to you, you accept it on your claim number HGC-26-138204 with exactly the amount and payee the agent reads you, and you do not change or round them. If the agent says nothing more is owed on the garage, you accept that answer. Once you hear that the garage supplemental has been accepted and issued, you thank them, say you will watch for the check, and end the call.

seed_consistency.check: Theft claim HGC-23-117406 opened 2023-08-31 for a 2023-08-30 loss while the policy was in force (original effective 2010-04-15).
Personal property theft RC 2,140.00 did not exceed the then 2,500.00 all-other-perils deductible, so it was denied below_deductible; no payment, so the claim never counts as paid.
Closed 2023-09-14 once its only coverage part was denied and nothing was withheld.
Hail claim HGC-24-125913 reported the day after the 2024-07-11 loss, inside the 365-day reporting period.

Roof surfacing aged 15 (2009 to 2024) was within the Premier 15-year replacement-cost roof age, so it settled acv_initial: 7,650.00 - 1,500.00 - 5,000.00 (1 percent of the then 500,000.00 Coverage A) = 1,150.00, below the 2,500.00 co-payee threshold -> insured.
The 1,500.00 depreciation of the acv_initial payment was withheld the same day, sourced to that payment.
No proof of repair arrived within 365 days of 2024-08-02; the whole 1,500.00 holdback was forfeited 2025-08-04 (roof_install_year still 2009: never replaced).
Closed 2025-08-04 once its only holdback was forfeited.
Windstorm claim HGC-26-138204 reported 2026-06-23 for the 2026-06-22 loss, in force (term 2026-04-15 to 2027-04-15), one day into the reporting period.

The July adjuster measured the roof surfacing on its actual-cash-value basis 10,700.00 against a 2 percent deductible 10,800.00 and denied it below_deductible; the RC 14,400.00 and depreciation 3,700.00 compared are recorded on the denial. The declarations carry 1 percent (5,400.00), so this denial is the open item the reversal settles.

Garage acv_initial on the same day: 26,300.00 - 6,700.00 - 10,800.00 absorbed = 8,800.00, payable to insured and mortgagee (>= 2,500.00, mortgagee on file). The 10,800.00 absorbed reflects the same 2 percent misreading and is what the supplemental corrects.
6,700.00 depreciation withheld from the garage acv_initial, sourced to it.

Final invoice 24,950.00 received 2026-09-02, 54 days after the 2026-07-10 acv payment (inside 365 days): release = min(6,700.00, min(24,950.00, 26,300.00) - 19,600.00) = 5,350.00; 1,350.00 of holdback still stands.
Recoverable depreciation payment of the 5,350.00 release, same payee rule as the original garage payment.

HO-5 Premier, in force, Coverage A 540,000.00 inside 350,000-1,500,000, wind/hail 1 percent from the tier's [1, 2] options, aop 2,500.00 from the tier's options, water backup 15,000.00 = included limit, mortgagee on file. roof_settlement roof_surfacing_schedule: re-evaluated at the 2026-04-15 renewal with the roof aged 17 (> 15, asphalt not exempt), as home_renewal and home_bind_eligibility require.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.home_policy_id: fbccd736-3f93-4544-98fa-c8d0dff18915 — Id class. Basis: the tool docstring asks for 'reference number of the HomeGuard policy the claim is made under, as returned by the home policy lookup for the verified customer'; find_home_policies(customer_id) at step 2 returns exactly one policy, HG5-1273-4408, whose id is this value. Uniqueness: the customer holds one HomeGuard policy; no other candidate is reachable.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.claim_number: HGC-26-138204 — Verbatim class. Basis: the customer says 'your claim number is HGC-26-138204' and the claim lookup (step 3) returns first-notice entry initial_state.home_claims.6b610dba-1d91-48b1-8329-250a9e903019 with claim_number HGC-26-138204; the policy rule fixes 'The claim concerned is the one whose first-notice entry is the latest on the policy'. Uniqueness: the other first-notice entries (HGC-24-125913, HGC-23-117406) are earlier.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.source_entry_id: 208d660d-37c5-4a5a-9885-1d54a8a17d35 — Id class. Basis: the docstring asks for the 'below-deductible denial entry of the roof surfacing that this payment replaces'; the claim lookup returns exactly one denial entry on HGC-26-138204 with coverage_part dwelling, property_class roof_surfacing and denial_reason below_deductible. Uniqueness: the only other denial on the policy (HGC-23-117406) is a personal-property theft denial of another claim.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.payment_type: roof_schedule — Enum class. Basis: rule sentence 'The payment is roof_schedule when the declarations carry the roof surfacing schedule, replacement_cost_full when the covered amount is the full replacement-cost value, and acv_initial with the recorded depreciation withheld otherwise'; the policy's roof_settlement is roof_surfacing_schedule (set at the 2026-04-15 renewal). Uniqueness: replacement_cost_full and acv_initial belong to the replacement-cost basis, which the declarations do not carry.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.roof_age_years: 17 — Fixed-format class, integer years. Basis: 'The roof's age for the band is the calendar year of the date of loss minus the roof install year on the declarations': 2026 - 2009 = 17. Uniqueness: the date of loss comes from the first-notice entry; the prior claim's recorded 15 belongs to a different loss.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.deductible_applied: 5400.00 — Fixed-format class, USD 2 decimals. Basis: occurrence deductible for a wind or hail loss = larger of 1 percent x Coverage A 540,000.00 = 5,400.00 and the HO-5 Premier minimum 2,500.00 = 5,400.00; waiver not reached (replacement-cost values on the claim's denial entries and on its payment entries that replace no denial: 14,400.00 + 26,300.00 = 40,700.00 < 100,000.00); the roof surfacing absorbs the smaller of 5,400.00 and its covered amount 7,920.00 = 5,400.00. The 10,800.00 on the July garage entry is a 2 percent figure the declarations do not carry.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.amount: 4700.00 — calculated: covered = 14,400.00 x 55 percent = 7,920.00 (the declarations carry the roof surfacing schedule; roof age 2026 - 2009 = 17 -> band 17 to 18); less deductible absorbed 5,400.00; less roof money already issued on the claim 0.00; plus code-upgrade 10 percent (built 1961, ordinance-or-law 25), tear-off 5 percent (asphalt, RC >= 10,000.00) and matching 5 percent (asphalt roof 17 years old, 10 to 19) = 20 percent x 14,400.00 = 2,880.00; plus emergency tarping 450.00 (reported 1 day after the loss); less prior unrepaired roof deduction 1,150.00 (HGC-24-125913 roof money issued, holdback forfeited). 7,920.00 - 5,400.00 + 2,880.00 + 450.00 - 1,150.00 = 4,700.00, floored at 0.00 and rounded to the cent.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.payee: insured_and_mortgagee — Enum class. Basis: base home_claim_settlement 'A dwelling or other_structures payment at or above mortgagee_copayee_threshold is payable to insured_and_mortgagee when a mortgagee is on file'; 4,700.00 >= 2,500.00 and the policy carries mortgagee Olentangy Valley Savings Bank. 'insured' applies only below the threshold or with no mortgagee.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.amount: 15258.00 — calculated on the world after the roof reversal: settled basis = smaller of other-structures replacement-cost value 26,300.00 and largest documented incurred cost 24,950.00 on the 2026-09-02 release, less the deductible the other structures absorb 0.00 (occurrence deductible 5,400.00 less 5,400.00 now carried on the claim's dwelling payment entries) = 24,950.00 (structure_settlement_method: release-standing tier); less money already issued on the part 8,800.00 + 5,350.00 = 14,150.00; plus overhead and profit 10 percent (three trades: the garage acv_initial, the roof roof_schedule reversal, the same-date FloodGuard detached-structures payment) + permit 2 percent (26,300.00 >= 25,000.00) + haul-away 4 percent (depreciation 6,700.00 >= 25 percent of 26,300.00) = 16 percent x 26,300.00 = 4,208.00; plus member-tenure credit 250.00 (197 whole months since 2010-04-15, two claims with a loss date in the 36 months before the call — the 2023-08-30 theft loss falls just outside). 24,950.00 - 14,150.00 + 4,208.00 + 250.00 = 15,258.00.

plain bindings: cn HGC-26-138204 (wind_hail); rc 14,400.00 / dep 3,700.00 from the below-deductible roof denial; paid_roof 0.00; declarations carry roof_surfacing_schedule (set at the 2026-04-15 renewal, roof aged 17 > 15, asphalt not exempt) -> covered = 14,400.00 x 55 percent (band 17 to 18, 2026 - 2009 = 17) = 7,920.00; occurrence deductible max(1% x 540,000.00, 2,500.00) = 5,400.00; waiver sum 40,700.00 < 100,000.00; absorbed min(5,400.00, 7,920.00) = 5,400.00; result = max(0, round(7,920.00 - 5,400.00 - 0.00 + 14,400.00 x 20 / 100 + 450.00 - 1,150.00, 2)) = 4,700.00.

member_tenure_credit (parameter, multi-source): 197 whole months since 2010-04-15 (>= 180) AND two claims with a loss date in the 36 months before the call (2024-07-11, 2026-06-22; the 2023-08-30 theft loss is 36 months back and excluded) -> 250.00. Baseline 0 would give 15008.00.

plain bindings: cn = HGC-26-138204; rc_os 26,300.00 / dep_os 6,700.00 from the garage acv_initial; paid_os = 8,800.00 + 5,350.00 = 14,150.00; occ_ded 5,400.00; occ_rc_total 40,700.00 < 100,000.00 (the roof payment replaces a denial and is not counted twice); dw_abs 5,400.00 (the roof reversal written at step 7) -> os_ded = max(0, min(26,300.00, 5,400.00 - 5,400.00)) = 0.00; result = max(0, round(24,950.00 - 14,150.00 + 26,300.00 x 16 / 100 + 250.00, 2)) = 15,258.00.

edges.condition: Where the claim carries a below-deductible denial entry of dwelling roof surfacing, the claim also carries a dwelling roof surfacing home_claim_payment entry (with the deductible the roof surfacing absorbs), so the deductible left for the other structures is the occurrence deductible less the deductible on the claim's dwelling payment entries.
edges.policy_source: The other-structures supplemental figure is fixed only after the roof surfacing of the same claim carries a payment entry wherever that roof surfacing was denied below the deductible.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The claim's roof surfacing stands only as a below-deductible denial entry with no roof surfacing payment entry; the deductible on the claim's dwelling payment entries is therefore 0.00, while the whole misread 10,800.00 sits on the garage entry.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The roof reversal writes a dwelling roof_surfacing payment with deductible_applied 5,400.00; dw_abs becomes 5,400.00, the deductible left for the other structures becomes 0.00, and the trade count rises from 2 to 3.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: Single edge, no parallel prerequisites: the roof reversal must precede the garage supplemental. Replaying the garage supplemental before the reversal gives 8,543.00 instead of 15,258.00 (deductible left 5,400.00 and 5 percent overhead and profit), so only the topological order reproduces gold.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the roof reversal (step 7) and replaying the rest: dw_abs 5,400.00 -> 0.00, os_ded 0.00 -> 5,400.00, job_trades 3 -> 2 (overhead and profit 10 -> 5 percent); the garage supplemental falls from 15,258.00 to 8543.00, and the terminal ledger also lacks the 3,530.00 roof payment.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: The persona speaks only of the garage and its July deductible; it never mentions the roof, the roof denial, the dwelling or any other part of the claim, and its only reference to preliminary work is a passive consent ('If the agent tells you that something else on the claim has to be put right ... you tell them to go ahead').
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: accept_structure_supplemental_c73fec14 reads the claim's first-notice entry for its locating fields and writes the supplemental as given: it checks no dwelling entry, no deductible and no roof status, raises nothing and hints nothing. settle_denied_roof_surfacing_b6cb399f likewise records the payment as given without judging eligibility.
